probe.action: Enabled the installed candidate through Obsidian PluginManager to diagnose why the prior startup profile had an empty loaded-plugin set.
probe.result: Candidate loaded as 0.14.0; no Reader view was opened. This was an in-process activation probe, not a process-start measurement or Native learning-loop acceptance.
probe.restoration: Disabled and unloaded the candidate with PluginManager, saved the disabled plugin list, and verified zero loaded plugins and zero Reader views.

observedSideEffects.details: Obsidian generated/refreshed the candidate's embedded asset cache and session logs while loading. These files were retained.

notes: The profile name suggested a temporary clone, but the active Obsidian DataAdapter resolved to the existing ObReader-Apple-Test Vault. The probe was limited to enabling then restoring the plugin state; no further Native actions were performed.
The test Vault remained Sync-disabled. This receipt intentionally omits its absolute local path.
Resource-v3 lookup measurements remain the separately recorded DataAdapter measurements and are not upgraded by this activation probe.
